dedupe_keys.name: baxtel data center directory global facilities colocation inventory and news

description: Baxtel is a commercial data centre intelligence platform that lets users find and compare data centres worldwide. Contents: facility pages with specifications, pricing and location maps, colocation inventory tracking across major markets, site-selection listings and infrastructure maps, datasets offered to customers, and daily industry news (for example on 28 September 2026: a cable landing station planned in Los Angeles and a withdrawn 90 MW campus in Sydney). Regional pages give market facts: the Africa page lists 127 data centres from 53 providers, with Teraco Data Environments the top provider at 9 sites and the largest facility a 132 MW site of Phoenix Group in Ethiopia. Producer: Baxtel, which also sells brokerage and advisory services. Coverage: worldwide, with strongest detail in major markets. Access: free browsing of directory and regional pages; full datasets and pricing require an enquiry or account, so registration is recorded as required for full use. Licence and cost: freemium, with commercial data terms not read. Caveats: listings are compiled by a company with commercial interests, capacities are not independently verified, and the free view shows only part of the data. Simulation uses: siting, capacity and exposure analysis of data centres, for example counting facilities in a hazard zone. Related records: the Cloudscene directory (data-cloudscene-data-centre-directory) and the Data Center Map directory (data-data-center-map-directory).
